```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Ambient

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

make_subplots(
  rows = 1,
  cols = 2,
  specs = list(list(list(type = "scene"), list(type = "scene")))
) |>
  add_surface(
    z = volcano,
    lighting = go_surface_lighting(ambient = 0.2),
    showscale = FALSE,
    row = 1,
    col = 1
  ) |>
  add_surface(
    z = volcano,
    lighting = go_surface_lighting(ambient = 0.9),
    showscale = FALSE,
    row = 1,
    col = 2
  ) |>
  update_scenes(aspectmode = "cube") |>
  update_layout(title = "Ambient Lighting")
```
